name: chest-double-and-break
comment: WP-1.8 BlockChest/BlockContainer on the stone platform with a player. t=1: two chests side by side (set_block; BlockContainer.onBlockAdded makes each a TileEntityChest). t=2: use_item with an empty hand on the first (BlockChest.blockActivated: true, the GUI is EntityPlayer's no-op), then two use_item placements of a chest item (54) next to the pair, both refused by BlockChest.canPlaceBlockAt (a neighbour that already has a chest beside it), so placed false and the stack stays. t=3 and t=4: the chests are broken with set_block air (BlockChest.onBlockRemoval: the empty inventory scatters nothing, so no Block.chest Random draw; BlockContainer.onBlockRemoval removes the tile entity). rng_state every tick shows nothing here draws.
